abstract: Society needs alternatives to painful, expensive, and cumbersome injections for diseases like diabetes. Franko et al. developed cells that sense melatonin to deliver glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) therapy during sleep. This circadian-synchronized approach restored normal blood sugar in diabetic mice, advancing the field of smart cells for patient-centered circadian medicine.
